ideas.pitch: A training-free semantic routing gateway that intelligently directs incoming LLM queries between cheap local models and high-end Opus AI credits based on semantic complexity.
ideas.title: OpusRouter
ideas.why_it_could_win: Directly targets the $15,000 Opus AI Credits sponsor prize by showing judges a smart way to optimize token spend using exemplar indexes.

ideas.pitch: A visual compliance workflow engine that uses BPMN orchestration to run pre-deployment risk diagnosis and deterministic guardrails on multi-agent AI pipelines.
ideas.title: AgentBPMN Guard
ideas.why_it_could_win: Leverages the winning pattern of hard governance engineering and enterprise readiness that appeals heavily to incubator judges.

ideas.pitch: An engineering lifecycle intelligence daemon that automatically extracts architectural decisions from local git hooks and developer chats before team members rotate off projects.
ideas.title: DevFlow Capture
ideas.why_it_could_win: Solves an immediate, painful problem that hackathon organisers and technical judges face daily—losing institutional engineering knowledge.

ideas.title: MariaRAG Toolkit

ideas.title: KAgent Mesh
